Innovation & Roadmap.assessed_on: The assessment rests on the company's verified deployment of machine learning capabilities for working capital optimization and its targeted partnership to integrate third-party artificial intelligence for automated invoice processing. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed a formalized, multi-year product roadmap or dedicated patents regarding emerging trade finance technologies such as blockchain or document-checking AI.

evidence.claim: Core retail enterprise buyers on the platform include Costco, REI, Philips, Walgreens, Macy's, Sysco, Home Depot, and Nordstrom.
Supply chain clients also include major multinational brands such as ThermoFisher, Mondelez, Ulta, Giant Eagle, and HPE.
Achieved its first $1 billion single-day customer funding milestone in December 2024.
Facilitated early payment on over 42 million invoices in 2024, representing an average acceleration of 32 days early.
Operations span across more than 180 countries and territories worldwide.
Headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, with dedicated operations and support across nine additional regional office locations globally.
Cumulative funding raised by the entity stands at $568 million over 10 institutional investment rounds.
Latest capital injection was a $30.7 million Series E round completed on March 27, 2025.
Surpassed $500 billion in cumulative lifetime working capital funding delivered globally as of March 2026.

The company reports serving major corporate enterprise buyers on its working capital platform, including Costco, REI, ThermoFisher, Philips, Walgreens, Mondelez, Macy's, Sysco, Home Depot, Ulta, Nordstrom, Giant Eagle, and HPE.

The company launched its TReDS platform in India with State Bank of India and Dabur India as the first participants, and later entered into agreements with Central Bank of India and Union Bank of India.

Named Bank & Corporate Customers.assessed_on: We verified that the assessment rests on the company's clear, public disclosure of tier-one global enterprise buyers and major regional banking institutions utilizing its early payment and marketplace platform. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed the full breakdown of transaction volumes or formal contract details across its entire base of over 275,000 business customers.
